name: Karacharana Kritam
text:
करचरणकृतं वा कायजं कर्मजं वा
श्रवणनयनजं वा मानसं वापराधम् ।
विहितमविहितं वा सर्वमेतत्क्षमस्व
जय जय करुणाब्धे श्रीमहादेव शम्भो ॥
meaning: Whatever I have done through my hands, feet, body, actions, hearing, sight or thoughts, knowingly or unknowingly, may it be forgiven. Salutations to compassionate Mahadeva Shambho.
purpose: A prayer for honest reflection and forgiveness without becoming trapped in shame.
supports: Self-forgiveness; taking responsibility; noticing the effect of one’s words and actions; letting go of unproductive guilt.
when: At the end of the day, or after a period of reflection.
note: The client list has a close variant of this text; spelling and sandhi are regularised here for readability.
source: Shiva Aparadha Kshamapana Stotram, attributed to Adi Shankaracharya
